name: 43138 · Logan, OH
findings: ZIP 43138 (Logan) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43138 (Logan) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43138 (Logan) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
